decisions.reason: The safety shoe line sits in the firm's core business and costs little to carry given in-house production and existing distribution, and two years of evidence still leave its value uncertain rather than clearly disappointing.

Dropping the overlapping supportive insole C removed some cannibalisation, so the comfort insole is a cheap complementary option worth holding, although further consolidation of the insole range remains possible.
The ergonomic series had its own page, signalling committed and favourable prospects, so the option should be held and possibly expanded.
Firefighter and rescue boots depend on slow certification and tender cycles, so their value is still resolving and abandoning them now would forfeit the option prematurely.
The moulded insole is the flagship of the firm's direction and the surviving focus of the insole range, so it carries high expected value and warrants further commitment.
